extracted.intended_audience: students, professional writers, journalists, and editors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing and editing news copy according to The Associated Press style, covering usage, grammar, punctuation, capitalization, abbreviations, numerals, and newsroom procedures. Intended to produce clear, professional journalism consistent with AP standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grammar
rubrics_metrics.description: AP's rules on grammar to ensure clear, professional news writing and editing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Master the AP's rules on grammar so writing and editing achieve clarity and the professionalism expected of AP writers and editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spelling
rubrics_metrics.description: AP standards for spelling words consistently in news copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the AP-approved spellings as provided in the stylebook to maintain uniformity across reporting and editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Punctuation
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing punctuation usage in news text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use AP punctuation rules (e.g., guidance on commas, dashes, quotation punctuation) to promote clear, consistent copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: AP conventions for when to capitalize words, titles, and proper nouns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply AP capitalization rules (headlines, job titles, organizations, etc.) to ensure consistency and professionalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abbreviation
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for abbreviating names, titles, organizations, and terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use AP rules on abbreviations and acronyms (when to spell out vs. abbreviate, punctuation with abbreviations) as specified in specialty chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Word and numeral usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on correct word choice and numeral expression in copy (words vs. figures, usage conventions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Master AP rules on word and numeral usage, including specific usage decisions such as when to use 'more than' instead of 'over'; follow the stylebook's prescriptions for writing numbers and word choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choice of standard usage (e.g., 'more than' vs 'over')
rubrics_metrics.description: Preference guidance for commonly confused or variable expressions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow AP-preferred phrasing in cases of common usage ambiguity—example given: use 'more than' instead of 'over'—to align copy with AP style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity and professionalism
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall goal that writing and editing conform to AP's standards of clarity and professionalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt AP style to write and edit with the clarity and professionalism associated with The Associated Press; the stylebook is presented as the 'gold standard' for news writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency with world events and AP procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep style and usage up to date with evolving events, common usage, and AP newsroom procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the fully revised and updated edition to reflect current world events, changes in common usage, and AP procedures—consult latest edition for contemporary guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of specialty chapters and comprehensive index
rubrics_metrics.description: Navigate topic-specific guidance via specialty chapters and the stylebook's comprehensive index.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to specialty chapters (e.g., topics unique to certain beats) and use the comprehensive index to find AP rules relevant to specific reporting/editing situations.
